title: Statement Cycle Loading on Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility Arrangement Deposits
content:
**Collections note.** Dunning points are added to the deposit percentage of an Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility arrangement deposit according to the statement cycle printed on the account's latest statement — the ordinal of that statement since the balance last stood at zero or below.

| Statement cycle on the latest statement | Points added |
|---|---|
| 6 or higher | 3 |
| 3, 4 or 5 | 1 |
| 1 or 2 | 0 |

The points raise the deposit percentage itself, which is applied once.

**Reading the statement (hypothetical).** A latest statement printed as cycle 6 adds 3 points; cycle 5 adds 1; cycle 3 adds 1; cycle 2 adds none. Only the latest statement's cycle is read; earlier statements do not change the result.
